required_mvp.name: salary_expenses_receipt
required_mvp.proof: Edit salary; add a manual expense; scan a receipt; review and correct amount/date/shop/category before saving.

required_mvp.name: monthly_dashboard
required_mvp.proof: Use month navigation to inspect spend vs salary, category breakdown, largest expenses and previous-month comparison.

required_mvp.name: forecast_insights
required_mvp.proof: Inspect projected month spend, expected remaining spend, expected money left/shortfall and three amount-backed written insights.

required_mvp.name: savings_pockets_dps
required_mvp.proof: Create a pocket and inspect forecast-adjusted contribution, expected completion date and DPS value at the stated editable annual rate.

dps_rule: Each month add deposit first, calculate annualRate/12 monthly interest on the balance, round half-up to paisa, then add interest to balance for compounding.
limitations: Receipt OCR depends on an external Gemini service.
Forecast is a deterministic pace projection, not financial advice.
DPS output is an illustration, not a bank quote.
